raw_record.question_text: The diameter of $\odot S$ is $30$ units, the diameter of $\odot R$ is $20$ units, and $DS=9$ units. Find $CD$.

method.method_draft: From the diagram, read that R, C, D, and S lie on the same straight line, with C on the left side of circle S and D between C and S. Read from the text that the diameter of circle S is 30, so its radius is 15, and that DS = 9. Since C is the point where the line through S meets circle S on the left, SC = 15. Along the same line, CD = SC - SD = 15 - 9 = 6.

method.method_draft: From the diagram, read that R, C, D, and S are collinear; D is the rightmost point of circle R on this line, and C is the left intersection of the line with circle S. From the text, circle R has diameter 20, so RD = 10, and DS = 9, so RS = RD + DS = 19. Circle S has diameter 30, so SC = 15. Since C lies between R and S, RC = RS - SC = 19 - 15 = 4. Then CD = RD - RC = 10 - 4 = 6.
